profile.headline: Software Engineer | Computer Graphics specialist | PhD
profile.summary:
I have a PhD from Purdue University and a strong background in Mathematics and Computer Science. 
Currently, I work at Google in Platforms & Ecosystems as a SWE. My primary areas of expertise are Computer Graphics and Additive Manufacturing. My experiences as a software developer include both industry and the academy. 
I am a proficient programmer and algorithm thinker, especially in C/C++. Since I’m a Computer Graphics developer, I usually work with OpenGL and GLSL. 
I am looking to develop my career in a technology company where I can make graphical applications that impact users around the world. Even though my professional background is technical, I come from a family of artists. Because of that, I am always interested in positions where I can work in a multidisciplinary environment with people from diverse backgrounds.

positions.description:
Platforms & Ecosystems
GPU Power consumption benchmarks for mobile Android XR devices.
Worked on Jetpack Compose extensions for XR development
App compatibility for Android XR: making sure that traditional android app are usable on VR
Help to bring a Unity game to our platform

positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Stadia
Supported partners in bringing their games to our platform
Vulkan and DX11, DX12

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
3D mobile graphics team (formerly browsers team).
Vulkan extension for Android
Work in a Safety project for automotive using PLC L3
Developed web components for ISAAC SDK 
Contributed in the design, develop and test of a library for Virtual and Augmented reality
Performed a comparison (by creating an app) of different augmented reality SDK's on mobile using Unreal Engine

positions.title: Graduate Research and Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching assistant in Computer Graphics programming courses: 
My activities included: Design teaching material, practices and quizzes, and grading. 
The courses were focused in C++ and OpenGL programming (CGT215) and web development in both front end (CGT353) using HTML, CSS, Javascript and backed (CGT456) using MS MVC, C# and MS SQL server.
Research assistant at the HPCG lab: 
I primarily work in Additive Manufacturing (3D printing), Geometrical Modeling and Scientific Visualization. 
My activities include: research, algorithm design, mathematical modeling and C++ programming using OpenGL and Qt.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
Procedural Image Group
Designed a real time deferred rendering engine for an interactive sculpting application
Implemented shadow mapping, global ambient occlusion and PBR shading algorithms on the GPU using GLSL shaders

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
OpenGL driver team:
Ported OpenGL extensions to expos them in the driver API
Repaired several bugs in the driver to correct calculations of 3rd party applications
Communicated with engineers from different companies around the world to delimit bug reports

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
DirectX Driver Team
Created an image format converter using nVidia assemble language
Wrote several shaders in HLSL for a video format conversion program
Developed C functions to test algorithms inside the driver

positions.title: Lecturer - Teacher
positions.description:
Taught two classes: Graph Theory and Computer Graphics
Created didactic material including slides, quizzes and notes
Provided feedback to students during extracurricular mentorship hours

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Institute of Applied Mathematics and Systems, Computer Science department
Developed programs for analysis of digital images for 3D reconstruction of blood vessels
Operated a fondus camera to capture images of the retina
Created a pipeline of several program using Bash to automate the digital image processing

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Collaborated in teaching two classes: Modern Geometry and Introduction to Computer Science
Created didactic material including demo programs and slides
Guided students for installing software and learn best practices in programming

positions.title: Laboratory Assistant
positions.description:
Software Development and Information Technology Unit
Built a web site using Linux, Apache, MySQL and PHP
Developed various small applications in PHP and Java for data collection
Administrated an SVN based control version system for the rest of the developers

positions.title: Intern, Q.A. and developer
positions.description:
Developed various applications in Java for text processing
Helped in a migration of a DB from Interbase to Oracle
Worked migrating an application from PowerHouse to Java
